responsibilities.quote: Staff have a responsibility to ensure that students are supported to use generative AI tools ethically and responsibly
Staff are expected to have the necessary foundational level knowledge and skills to use generative AI tools effectively and responsibly as appropriate for their discipline

Staff will be supported through the launch of a new self-enrol AI for Educators course on Blackboard Ultra, AI Exploration days and workshops on Critical AI Literacy including assessment, active learning and ethical use.
Use of Generative AI in teaching, learning and assessment must comply with associated University Codes of Practice, Guidance, Policies and Procedures

This framework will evolve as the use of AI in education develops. Keele is committed to regular review and updates to keep pace with technological advancements and ensure best practices are followed.
Staff and students will have fair access to Gen AI tools and resources needed for teaching and learning
Staff should ensure equitable access to generative AI tools and resources for all students regardless of background, location, or personal financial situation
Responsible use means critically evaluating AI in this way and ensures AI outputs are managed eﬀectively and responsibly.
